text:
sam: Short thread to lock a minimal observability console scope for next sprint. Need concrete acceptance tests so eng can start.
nina: Purpose: dashboards for cost/latency/errors + a light trace link for request->model. No long retention or ML RCA in MVP.
rajesh: Instrumentation checklist: 1) spans: http_recv -> route_decision -> queue -> kv_cache_hit/miss -> model_exec; 2) propagate X-RW-TRACE header; 3) sampling default 1% + org toggle to 100% for 24h.
claire: Dashboard UX: per-route table (7d) with requests, est cost, p95, error%. Click -> model breakdown (top 5). No deep drilldowns.
ops-bot: ALERT POLICY: p99 > 1.5x SLO for 5m -> page oncall; error rate > 3x baseline for 10m -> page + auto-fallback.
rajesh: Note: need PII scrubber before trace persistence. Also add rate limit on dashboard queries (default per-org QPS).
sam: Acceptance: dashboards load <2.5s for top queries, trace link opens to a sample trace, cost panel matches billing sample within 5% for test customers, runbook with 3 recovery steps documented.
nina: In-scope: per-model cost summary, basic traces, error-class buckets, canary fallback. Out-of-scope: per-token billing, 90d retention, automated RCA.
claire: I'll draft the CS "what's included" note if we lock. Reply with thumbs by 18:00 PST.
ops-bot: branch created: obs/mvp-scope -> CI queued.
sam: Locking scope at 18:00 PST unless objections. :thumbsup:
